name: God Helmet: modulated 40 Hz both sides, then hippocampus right (60 min)
origin: Todd Murphy (Shiva God Helmet software); signal templates licensed from Persinger & Koren
summary: Todd Murphy's two-phase Shiva God Helmet session: the 'modulated 40 Hz' signal over both temporal lobes, then the hippocampal 'LTP' signal over the right temporal lobe. The vendor expects inner silence, deep calm, inner images and spaciousness, with a possible 'psychic' undertone; 60-minute version.
notes: 60-minute version (30 + 30 min, switching abruptly); the vendor also offers a 40-minute version (murphy-gh-mod40bi-hippr-40min). Four coils per temporal lobe in a cross centred near T7/T8 (an inference from 'four coils over each temporal lobe'); the field steps from coil to coil, 'clockwise over the left side, counter-clockwise over the right' as the vendor states, read with each side seen from its own side, so both sides step top, back, bottom, front (C5-TP7-T9-FT7 and C6-TP8-T10-FT8; an inference). An image caption on the vendor's session list says the signals cycle clockwise on the right side, which contradicts the text; this preset follows the text. The step time is unpublished (Murphy: one cycle takes 'a fraction of a second'), so 125 ms per coil (0.5 s per cycle) is used. The 'modulated 40 Hz' file is proprietary; the vendor calls it a signal 'almost in sync with the brain's own binding factor, but not quite' and, on its Shakti pages, a 'constant tone'. It is approximated by a continuous 40 Hz carrier whose phase swings up to 3 rad ahead of and behind a steady 40 Hz every 2 s (38.5-41.5 Hz). The hippocampal 'LTP' file is proprietary; it is approximated by the project's Larson & Lynch theta-burst table (4 pulses at 100 Hz per burst) at the 5.4 Hz spectral peak the vendor reports for this signal, 4 bursts (0.6 s), then the vendor's standard 4-s silence; the burst count is a choice, and 0.5-ms points replace the vendor's 3-ms points because 100 Hz pulses need them. 1 µT follows Persinger's papers, which mostly report about 1 µT (10 mG), and the vendor's '10mG' calibration for the modulated 40 Hz signal; the vendor's other figures disagree (10-20 mG on one page, a 50 or 90 mG 'laboratory standard' on others). If anxiety or fear appears during or after phase 2, never reuse this session (vendor). The vendor calls the session 'a bit experimental'. Not for people prone to anxiety. The vendor reports headache or pressure in about 2% with the hippocampal signal; if so, lower the intensity by one third. The 'hippocampus on the right' rule rests on a small Persinger-lab study (Persinger, Richards & Koren 1994: LTP-pattern fields over the right hemisphere were rated more pleasant than over the left). Vendor exclusions: epilepsy or seizure history, psychiatric conditions or medication, migraine, brain injury, drugs. Stop on any distress. Independent double-blind tests found no effect of the fields (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012).
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence (the vendor: 'silence, not just quiet'), blindfold or eyes closed; sit or lie relaxed without meditating or falling asleep. The vendor prefers night sessions on geomagnetically quiet days and a helper who can stop the session. No meditation, mind machines or drugs at the same time.
schedule: Vendor rules: God Helmet sessions at most weekly, up to 6, then a 21-day break; for 60-minute sessions the Shiva pages say weekly or every two weeks and the Shakti pages at most every 3 weeks (the longer gap is the cautious choice). Never on consecutive days; not mixed with Shiva or Shakti sessions in the same weeks; try a session 2-3 times before changing it.
